apo.customText: Enter the text to appear when hovering the mouse pointer over the Map Note
apo.useImg: Image path for image to appear when hovering the mouse pointer over the Map Note
apo.hideOverlay: Hide Custom Overlay when hovering (not for GM)

settings.allPinVisibleHint: Name of each Map Note will be always visible with out need for hovering.
settings.showNotConectedPin: Always show Map Pin not connected to Journal
settings.showNotConectedPinHint: All Map Pins not connectet to Journal will be visible for all Users

apo.hideFromUser: Select users which can't see this Pin
apo.showtouser: Select users which can see this Pin
apo.colorOFBackground: Select background color for Custom Overlay
apo.position: Select direction where Custom Overlay should be display
apo.pixelOffset: Offset of Custom Overly in pixel
apo.hoverTimeDelay: How long Custom Overly stay when mouse is not hover on it in miliseconds
apo.scaleWithZomm: Scale Label Font with Canvas Zoom
